title: HandLive — shared SMS objects
description: SMS-01 API 1, "Shared data objects": the thread and message objects used by sms/sync, sms/history and sms/new, and the unread entry of sms/sync and sms/read_changed. $defs only; reference them as sms-common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>.

address.description: e164 (0.3): E.164 using the country of the default SIM; a string that cannot be normalized (short code, sender name such as VIETTEL) is kept as it is.

sub-id.description: sub_id of the SIM; the provider's -1 is sent as null.

thread.description: Conversation summary (SMS-01 API 1, the thread object).

display_name.description: Contact names joined with ", "; null without READ_CONTACTS or when the number is not in the contacts.

snippet.description: Body of the newest SMS message, cut to 160 characters.

message.description: One SMS message (SMS-01 API 1, the message object). local_id only in the sms/new sent to the client that created the message (SMS-04).

body.description: The body column; null in the provider is sent as "".

box.description: From the type column: 1 inbox, 2 sent, 4 outbox, 5 failed, 6 queued; drafts (3) are never sent.

ts_sent.description: The date_sent column; 0 is sent as null.

local_id.description: local_id of the matching sms/send (SMS-04 API 4).

synced-message.description: A message in an sms/sync or sms/history ack: never carries local_id.

unread-entry.description: Unread state of one conversation on the phone (SMS-05 API 1): every inbox message with ts <= read_up_to_ts is read.
